requirements.description: User prefers properties near green spaces. Set at the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26, rounded to 74) to require proximity above the typical level.

User prefers Energy Class D or better, so all classes from D up to A4 are accepted. Floor area, capacity for 45 people, and proximity to green spaces are not energy-related and have no matching columns, so they are not included.
The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area, so this is applied as a minimum surface threshold.

output.explanation: Filters on school-type properties (property_type = 'Attività scolastiche'), surface_area >= 600, a 3.0 km haversine radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892, energy_class in A1–D, and green >= 74. The 45-person capacity has no matching column, so it is not filtered. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinates, nearest first.
